import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Convert is_fraud column to categorical variable for plotting
data['is_fraud'] = pd.Categorical(data['is_fraud'])

# Create a bar chart of transaction types by number of transactions
sns.set()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=data, ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Types by Fraud Status')
ax.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax.set_ylabel('Count')
ax.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
